text.p: The Jakarta stock exchange has suspended trading in small financing firm PT Clipan Finance Indonesia following a sharp rise albeit in small volumes, an exchange official said.
"The suspension was done as the rise was too high even though the trading volume was relatively small," an exchange official who declined to be named said.
The official said the exchange would issue an announcement about the suspension later today.
Clipan was up 225 rupiah at 1,125 rupiah, with around two million shares traded, before it was suspended at around 0645 GMT.
Brokers said the sudden active buying of Clipan was due to speculative reasons including talk of a possible take-over.
